title: See why a session is waiting
done: That is it: waiting sessions come first, each with its reason.

steps.caption: The Sessions panel lists every session, with its state.
Here the demo is put on Hold, so that it waits for you.
Under the session, the reason it waits: a question, a permission, or your own Hold.
Released, it is at work again, and the reason goes.
Your turn: choose Waiting first, so that the sessions waiting for you come to the top.
